currentSnapshot: Working-tree source hashes identify the inspected files independently of currentBaseCommit.
scope: Show Log main dialog visible controls and pane organization.
Reference, limit, walk and view control-menu inventory.
Actual revision and changed-file context command inventory, with selected conditional menu gates inspected.
Source implementation checks for two apparent omissions; source comments alone are not treated as implemented behavior.

references.contract: Changed-file context mask excludes restore and changelists
Clears changed-file report before branching on selected revision count
Multiple-revision branch contains aggregation comment but no report-population implementation
Default Log context mask removes rebase actions, ordinary Show Log and revision Blame/BlamePrevious
Revision context menu commands and selection/reference-dependent branches
Changed-file comparison, working-file, history, export/open, prepared comparison and clipboard commands
Selection clears old report and starts historical details only for a single revision
Reference, limit, walk and view menus
Revision context menu commands, conditional branches and clipboard/find submenu
Consumer-specific Log, Blame and Rebase command policies

result.conclusion: No additional proven missing end-user command/control found within this bounded Show Log source inventory audit.

ruledOutFalseGaps.candidate: Revision-list Blame and Blame previous missing from ordinary Show Log
ruledOutFalseGaps.reason: Pinned GitLogListBase constructor masks both commands out for the ordinary Log consumer. Changed-file Blame is separately present in the current file menu.

ruledOutFalseGaps.candidate: Multiple selected revisions should populate a union of changed files
ruledOutFalseGaps.reason: Pinned LogDlg clears the report before selection branching. Its multi-selection branch only clears Gravatar and contains an aggregation comment; it does not populate the report. The comment alone does not prove a missing implementation in the port.

excluded: Exhaustive execution of every conditional revision/file menu combination
Physical appearance, keyboard/default-button and pane geometry acceptance
Full Git-operation, cancellation, lifetime and security-scope runtime behavior
Blame/Rebase consumer-specific context menus beyond policy inspection
Installed build 39 commit/file inspection evidence as a substitute for full parity
Graphics/WMF, CI, packaging and dialog-ledger completion counts

validation.claim: This bounded inventory audit does not certify complete behavioral/visual parity, hosted CI, signed Finder integration or the whole port.
